title: Chicken and mushroom stew with butter beans

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple, such as chicken stock, tinned butter beans, crème fraîche and Dijon mustard.

supermarket.reason: Drumsticks, mushrooms, kale, butter beans and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco items at ordinary prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: Eight drumsticks, two tins of beans and 400g mushrooms make a fair dinner for four, and 35 minutes covered with 300ml stock plus the mushroom juices will cook the chicken through without leaving it dry or swimming.

honest_times.reason: The 20 minutes of prep covers chopping, browning and stirring, the 40 minutes of cook time matches the 35-minute simmer plus 5 minutes to wilt the kale, and the hands-on work stays short enough for a quick weeknight.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the fresh thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming chicken stew suits mid-January, and 400g of mushrooms named in the title make them a main part of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British instructions a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chicken, beans, mushrooms and kale in a creamy mustard sauce make a filling, balanced family dinner.
